info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 List voice command definitions

items.docs: Retrieves the list of installed Voice Command Definition (VCD) sets. Each VCD set defines a group of voice commands that Cortana can recognize for a specific application, including command names, phrases, and feedback text.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Install a voice command definition

items.docs: Installs a VCD file using VoiceCommandDefinitionManager.InstallCommandDefinitionsFromStorageFileAsync. The VCD file is an XML document that defines the commands, example phrases, and phrase lists that Cortana will recognize for the application.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Get a voice command set

params.name: commandSetName
params.description: The name of the voice command set

items.docs: Retrieves a specific voice command set by name. The command set contains the language, name, and all defined commands including their phrases and phrase lists.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Update a phrase list

params.name: commandSetName
params.description: The name of the voice command set

params.name: phraseListName
params.description: The name of the phrase list to update

items.docs: Updates a phrase list within a voice command set using VoiceCommandDefinition.SetPhraseListAsync. Phrase lists are dynamic vocabularies that can be updated at runtime without reinstalling the VCD file.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Create a Cortana app service connection

items.docs: Establishes a connection to the Cortana app service for handling voice commands in the background. Uses VoiceCommandServiceConnection to receive voice commands, display progress, and return results to Cortana.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Send a response to Cortana

items.docs: Sends a VoiceCommandResponse back to Cortana containing content tiles, a message, and an app launch argument. Uses VoiceCommandResponse.CreateResponse to format the response for display in the Cortana canvas.
